snippet.title: Psycho-Sleuth | Launches Nov 5! Commit Murder Undetected to Become a God.
snippet.description:
Hello everyone!
We are thrilled to announce that Psycho-Sleuth officially launches on November 5, 2026!

Steam Page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432860/PsychoSleuth/]

---

Psycho-Sleuth is a murder mystery puzzle game blending cognitive disorders with fair-play detective reasoning.

Trapped in a brutal death game with 12 others, everyone suffers from a unique—and contagious—cognitive plague: one cannot lie, another loses left-side vision, another can't recognize faces...

The rule is simple: Commit murder undetected, and become a God.
When your senses, memories, and words are all corrupted—can you unmask the truth?

---

With launch less than two months away, a massive THANK YOU to everyone who played our Demo, reported bugs, and shared feedback! You helped shape this game.

The free Demo (Chapter 1 + Chapter 2 setup) is still live!

If you're excited for launch, please Wishlist the game today! ❤️
